title: Professional Services Projects Engagement Class Schedule
content:
Every Professional Services Projects statement of work belongs to one of six engagement classes, ranked from Assessment Engagement (rank 1) to Strategic Program (rank 6). The class follows from the original contract value of the statement of work and from its scope: an assessment-only scope is an Assessment Engagement, and every other class is an implementation class. Each figure below applies to every engagement of the class in whose column it stands.

## Class bands and signing terms

| Figure | Assessment Engagement | Quick Start Project | Standard Project | Advanced Project | Major Project | Strategic Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lowest original contract value of the class (USD) | 2500.00 | 2500.00 | 10000.00 | 50000.00 | 150000.00 | 500000.00 |
| Highest original contract value of the class (USD) | 7500.00 | 9999.99 | 49999.99 | 149999.99 | 499999.99 | no maximum |
| Scope of the class | assessment only | implementation | implementation | implementation | implementation | implementation |
| Pricing models the class may be signed under | fixed fee | fixed fee; time and materials | fixed fee; time and materials | fixed fee; time and materials | fixed fee; time and materials | fixed fee; time and materials |
| Calendar days after issue within which the statement of work may be signed at its quoted price | 30 | 30 | 30 | 45 | 60 | 90 |

## Delivery entitlements of the class

| Figure | Assessment Engagement | Quick Start Project | Standard Project | Advanced Project | Major Project | Strategic Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A named project manager runs the engagement | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| How often written status reports are sent | at completion | weekly | weekly | weekly | weekly | weekly |
| Executive steering meeting cadence | none | none | none | monthly | biweekly | weekly |
| A written findings report with remediation roadmap is a deliverable | yes | no | no | no | no | no |

## Notes on reading the schedule

- Assessment Engagement and Quick Start Project share the lowest value of 2500.00. Between 2500.00 and 7500.00 the scope decides the class: an assessment-only scope is an Assessment Engagement, an implementation scope a Quick Start Project.
- Assessment Engagement lists only fixed fee as a pricing model, so an assessment is never signed on time and materials; every implementation class lists both models.
- Strategic Program has no highest value: every implementation statement of work of 500000.00 or more falls in it.
- Hypothetical illustration: an implementation statement of work with an original contract value of 9999.99 sits in the Quick Start Project band, and one of 10000.00 in the Standard Project band.
